1198: rule manta:
1199:     input:
1200:         bqsr_bam = f"{BQSR_DIR}/{{sample}}_{SCRIPT_VERSION}.bam",
1201:         bqsr_bam_bai = f"{BQSR_DIR}/{{sample}}_{SCRIPT_VERSION}.bam.bai"
1202:     output:
1203:         manta_diploidSV_vcf = f"{MANTA_DIR}/{{sample}}/results/variants/diploidSV.vcf.gz",
1204:         manta_converted_vcf = f"{MANTA_DIR}/{{sample}}/results/variants/{{sample}}.diploidSV.conInv.vcf",
1205:         manta_coninv =        f"{MANTA_DIR}/{{sample}}/results/variants/{{sample}}.diploidSV.conInv_filtered.vcf"
1206:     params:
1207:         run_dir =           f"{MANTA_DIR}/{{sample}}",
1208:         conInv_out_prefix = f"{MANTA_DIR}/{{sample}}/results/variants/{{sample}}.diploidSV.conInv"
1209:     log:
1210:         err = f"{MANTA_DIR}/{{sample}}_manta.err"
1211:     benchmark:
1212:         f"{BENCHMARK_DIR}/{{sample}}.manta.benchmark"
1213:     resources:
1214:         mem_mb=config["memory"]["mem-5g"]
1215:     threads:
1216:         config['threads']['default']
1217:     priority:
1218:         config["PRIORITY"]["manta"]
1219:     run:
1220:         try:
1221:             shell("""
1222:                 
1223:                 {PYTHON2} {MANTA} --bam {input.bqsr_bam} --referenceFasta {REF} --runDir {params.run_dir}/ 1>> {log.err}
1224:                 
1225:                 {PYTHON2} {params.run_dir}/runWorkflow.py -j {threads} 1>> {log.err}
1226:                 
1227:                 {PYTHON2} {CONVERTINVERSION} {SAMTOOLS} {REF} \
1228:                     {output.manta_diploidSV_vcf} > {output.manta_converted_vcf} 2>> {log.err}
1229:                 
1230:                 {PYTHON3} {MANTAFILTER} {output.manta_converted_vcf} {params.conInv_out_prefix}
1231:                 
1232:                 exit_code=$?
1233:                 # exit_code 출력
1234:                 echo "[#status code] {rule} {wildcards.sample} $exit_code" >> {log.err}
1235:                 # status code 검사
1236:                 if [ "$exit_code" -ne 0 ];then
1237:                     echo "Error detected, status code is non-zero" >> {log.err}
1238:                     rm -rf {output.manta_diploidSV_vcf} {output.manta_converted_vcf} {output.manta_coninv}
1239:                     exit 1
1240:                 fi
1241:                 
1242:                 sha256sum {output.manta_coninv} > {output.manta_coninv}.sha256sum
1243:                 
1244:                 ln -s {output.manta_coninv} {INPUT_DIR}/outcome/{wildcards.sample}/{wildcards.sample}.diploidSV.conInv_filtered.vcf
1245:             """)   
1246:         except:
1247:             sample_id = {wildcards.sample}
1248:             step = {rule}
1249:             err_message = {log.err}
1250:             send_alarm(sample_id, step, err_message, INPUT_DIR)
